quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsubishi Gas Chemical press release: release 261022-2 (10-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Mitsubishi Gas Chemical's methanol demonstration facility at its Mizushima plant (the methanol step of the carbon-circular supply-chain demonstration with JFE Steel and Mitsubishi Chemical) confirmed, as planned, that reacting steelmaking by-product gas directly with hydrogen can produce methanol of quality equivalent to conventional product at an annual production scale of 100 tons; the facility is designed as a relocatable mobile plant, and MGC plans to extend the remote technical support run from its Niigata plant to customers adopting its methanol production process. The facility received support under a Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (Agency for Natural Resources and Energy) subsidy program in each of fiscal years 2024, 2025 and 2026 (a demonstration).
